questions.question: Select the most appropriate synonym of the given word: OBSTACLE
questions.explanation: Obstacle means a thing that blocks one's way or prevents or hinders progress. 'Barrier' is the synonym.

hi.question: दिए गए शब्द का सही पर्यायवाची (Synonym) चुनें: OBSTACLE
hi.explanation: Obstacle का अर्थ है बाधा या रुकावट। Barrier का अर्थ भी यही है।

questions.question: Fill in the blank: He was married _____ a doctor.
questions.explanation: The correct preposition with 'married' in this context is 'to'.

hi.question: रिक्त स्थान भरें: He was married _____ a doctor.
hi.explanation: 'Married' के साथ 'to' का प्रयोग होता है (जैसे: He is married to her), 'with' का नहीं।

questions.question: Identify the segment which contains a grammatical error. 'The cattle is grazing in the field.'
questions.explanation: 'Cattle' is a plural noun and takes a plural verb. It should be 'are grazing'.

hi.question: दिए गए वाक्य के किस भाग में व्याकरणिक त्रुटि है? 'The cattle is grazing in the field.'
hi.explanation: 'Cattle' (मवेशी) एक बहुवचन संज्ञा (plural noun) है, इसलिए इसके साथ 'are' का प्रयोग होना चाहिए।

questions.question: Select the meaning of the idiom: 'A dark horse'
questions.explanation: A dark horse is a candidate or competitor about whom little is known but who unexpectedly wins or succeeds.

hi.question: मुहावरे का अर्थ चुनें: 'A dark horse'
hi.explanation: छुपा रुस्तम (एक अप्रत्याशित विजेता)।

questions.question: Select the antonym of: ABUNDANT
questions.explanation: Abundant means existing in large quantities. Scarce means insufficient or rare.

hi.question: विलोम शब्द चुनें: ABUNDANT
hi.explanation: Abundant का अर्थ है प्रचुर। Scarce का अर्थ है कम या दुर्लभ।

questions.question: Improve the underlined part: Please *return back* the book I gave you.
questions.explanation: 'Return' means to give back. Using 'back' with 'return' is redundant (superfluous). Correct: 'Please return the book...'

hi.question: वाक्य सुधार: Please *return back* the book I gave you.
hi.explanation: 'Return' का अर्थ ही होता है 'वापस करना', इसलिए इसके साथ 'back' का प्रयोग गलत है।

questions.question: One word substitution: 'A person who does not believe in the existence of God'
questions.explanation: An Atheist is a person who disbelieves or lacks belief in the existence of God.

hi.question: एक शब्द प्रतिस्थापन: 'A person who does not believe in the existence of God'
hi.explanation: जो ईश्वर में विश्वास नहीं करता उसे Atheist (नास्तिक) कहते हैं।

questions.question: Select the correctly spelt word.
questions.explanation: The correct spelling is 'Vacuum' (single c, double u).

hi.question: सही वर्तनी चुनें।
hi.explanation: सही स्पेलिंग 'Vacuum' है (एक c, दो u)।

questions.question: Select the synonym of: FATAL
questions.explanation: Fatal means causing death. Deadly is the synonym.

hi.question: समानार्थक शब्द चुनें: FATAL
hi.explanation: Fatal का अर्थ है घातक या जानलेवा (Deadly)।

questions.question: Fill in the blank: He is _____ heir to the throne.
questions.explanation: The word 'heir' has a silent 'h' and starts with a vowel sound ('air'), so 'an' is used.

hi.question: रिक्त स्थान भरें: He is _____ heir to the throne.
hi.explanation: 'Heir' में 'h' साइलेंट होता है और उच्चारण 'एयर' होता है, इसलिए 'an' का प्रयोग होगा।

questions.question: Identify the error: 'My friend and benefactor have come.'
questions.explanation: When two nouns refer to the same person (indicated by the article 'My' used only once), the verb should be singular 'has'.

hi.question: त्रुटि ज्ञात करें: 'My friend and benefactor have come.'
hi.explanation: जब दो संज्ञाएं एक ही व्यक्ति को दर्शाती हैं (My एक ही बार लगा है), तो verb singular (has) होनी चाहिए।

questions.question: Select the correctly spelt word.
questions.explanation: The correct spelling is 'Committee' (double m, double t, double e).

hi.question: सही वर्तनी चुनें।
hi.explanation: सही स्पेलिंग 'Committee' है (दो m, दो t, दो e)।

questions.question: Meaning of the idiom: 'Call it a day'
questions.explanation: 'Call it a day' means to decide to stop working for the rest of the day.

hi.question: मुहावरे का अर्थ: 'Call it a day'
hi.explanation: इसका अर्थ है 'काम बंद करना' या 'आज के लिए बस इतना ही'।

questions.question: One word substitution: 'The scientific study of birds'
questions.explanation: Ornithology is the branch of zoology that concerns the study of birds.

hi.question: एक शब्द प्रतिस्थापन: 'The scientific study of birds'
hi.explanation: पक्षियों के अध्ययन को Ornithology (पक्षी विज्ञान) कहते हैं।

questions.question: Improve the sentence: I *am knowing* him for a long time.
questions.explanation: 'Know' is a stative verb and usually not used in continuous tense. With 'for a long time', we use Present Perfect. 'I have known him'.

hi.question: वाक्य सुधार: I *am knowing* him for a long time.
hi.explanation: 'Know' का प्रयोग continuous tense में नहीं होता। समय अवधि (for a long time) के साथ Present Perfect का प्रयोग होगा: 'have known'।

questions.question: Select the antonym of: CRUEL
questions.explanation: Cruel means wilfully causing pain. Kind means having a friendly, generous nature.

hi.question: विलोम शब्द चुनें: CRUEL
hi.explanation: Cruel (क्रूर) का विलोम Kind (दयालु) है।

questions.question: Fill in the blank: The police _____ arrested the thief.
questions.explanation: 'Police' is a plural noun, so it takes the plural verb 'have'.

hi.question: रिक्त स्थान भरें: The police _____ arrested the thief.
hi.explanation: 'Police' बहुवचन संज्ञा है, इसलिए इसके साथ 'have' का प्रयोग होगा।

questions.question: Identify the error: 'They discussed about the matter yesterday.'
questions.explanation: The verb 'discuss' is transitive and does not take the preposition 'about'. Correct: 'They discussed the matter'.

hi.question: त्रुटि ज्ञात करें: 'They discussed about the matter yesterday.'
hi.explanation: 'Discuss' के बाद 'about' का प्रयोग नहीं होता। सही वाक्य: 'They discussed the matter'.

questions.question: Fill in the blank: Beware _____ dogs.
questions.explanation: The correct phrase is 'Beware of'.

hi.question: रिक्त स्थान भरें: Beware _____ dogs.
hi.explanation: सही मुहावरा 'Beware of' (सावधान रहना) है।

questions.question: Meaning of the idiom: 'A bed of roses'
questions.explanation: A bed of roses means a situation or activity that is comfortable or easy.

hi.question: मुहावरे का अर्थ: 'A bed of roses'
hi.explanation: इसका अर्थ है 'बहुत आरामदायक स्थिति' या 'फूलों की सेज'।

questions.question: One word substitution: 'One who can speak two languages'
questions.explanation: Bilingual is a person fluent in two languages.

hi.question: एक शब्द प्रतिस्थापन: 'One who can speak two languages'
hi.explanation: दो भाषाएं बोलने वाले को Bilingual (द्विभाषी) कहते हैं।

questions.question: Improve the sentence: He is the *most unique* person I have ever met.
questions.explanation: 'Unique' means one of a kind. It cannot be qualified by 'more' or 'most'. Correct: 'He is a unique person'.

hi.question: वाक्य सुधार: He is the *most unique* person I have ever met.
hi.explanation: 'Unique' का अर्थ है सबसे अलग। इसके साथ 'most' या 'more' का प्रयोग नहीं होता।

questions.question: Select the correctly spelt word.
questions.explanation: The correct spelling is 'Maintenance' (ten, not tain).

hi.question: सही वर्तनी चुनें।
hi.explanation: सही स्पेलिंग 'Maintenance' है (ध्यान दें: mainTENance, mainTAIN नहीं)।

questions.question: Select the synonym of: GRIEF
questions.explanation: Grief means deep sorrow. Sorrow is the synonym.

hi.question: समानार्थक शब्द चुनें: GRIEF
hi.explanation: Grief का अर्थ है दुख। Sorrow का अर्थ भी दुख है।

questions.question: Fill in the blank: The cat is hiding _____ the table.
questions.explanation: 'Under' indicates being directly below something.

hi.question: रिक्त स्थान भरें: The cat is hiding _____ the table.
hi.explanation: मेज के नीचे के लिए 'under' का प्रयोग होगा।
